integrity: Analytic proof supplied with explicit rational factorization; computational checks are supporting, not substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly four two-periodic arcs; no assertion for arbitrary four-edge meshes or larger cycles; older spline literature may contain an equivalent explicit special case. The 2004 Franklin-system reference provides year-level, not day-level, bibliographic dating.
title: Sharp contrast profile for four-knot periodic linear-spline projection
